scene: The clanking cabin climbs, swaying gently toward the turning bridge.
beats: You untangle her golden yarn, and she gifts you a warm knitted patch. The crawler docks with a hiss, opening its doors by a whistling soup stall.
Through the glass, giant brass teeth mesh in slow, ticking rhythm. The cabin glides to a halt, and the doors slide open onto the busy tool walkway.
A soft chime rings out, dropping a tiny commemorative gear into your palm. The crawler jolts to a gentle stop as the doors open onto Gear Bridge.
picture: Inside the wooden crawler cabin, an old badger knits a long scarf on the left. The player stands beside a brass handrail, facing a round porthole window showing turning cogwheels in the centre. On the right, a sleepy driver sits beside a control console with a protruding copper lever.
shown: a striped wool scarf held by an old badger lady on the left
a round porthole window showing turning cogwheels in the centre
a loose copper lever protruding from the operator console on the right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay aboard as the crawler rattles past the bridge, gently startling the sleepy driver. Transferring to a roaring sidecar motorbike, you speed toward the glowing valves of Midnight Radio Repair.
after.then: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair

variants.scene: The wooden cabin creaks along the track while humming {tune}.
beats: You loosen a snag in her wool, earning a cozy knitted patch. With a slow hiss, the crawler docks beside a steamy soup stall, doors sliding wide.
Behind the glass, giant cog teeth grind peacefully in the sunset. The cabin eases to a standstill, sliding its doors open to a bustling walkway of tools.
A cheerful bell rings from the console, rolling a little commemorative gear into your fingers. The crawler gently brakes, opening onto Gear Bridge.
variants.ride_on: You ride beyond the stop, surprising the sleepy driver at the controls. Switching over to a roaring sidecar motorbike, you zoom off toward the bright valves of Midnight Radio Repair.

variants.scene: Warm lamplight glows as the timber tram rattles high above the city.
beats: You help gather her stray yarn, and she happily presents you with a stitched wool square. The crawler pulls in and doors part before a whistling soup stall.
You press close to see enormous brass wheels turn slowly together. The tram glides to a stop, opening right onto the lively tool walkway.
The small control clicks, popping a shiny souvenir gear right into your hand. With a soft thump, the car stops and doors open over Gear Bridge.
variants.ride_on: Remaining aboard, you roll past the bridge and wake the quiet driver. You hop into a sputtering sidecar motorbike, darting toward the glowing neon glow of Midnight Radio Repair.

variants.scene: Rhythmic clicks fill the air as the car ascends toward the crossing.
beats: You sort out the striped wool stitches, and the passenger gives you a bright knitted keepsake. The car halts smoothly as doors open near a whistling soup stall.
Massive interlocking teeth spin steadily beyond the glass frame. The cabin sighs to a halt, parting its doors to reveal the crowded tool walkway.
The control rattles softly and dispenses a tiny metal gear token for you. Shuddering gently to a stop, the crawler opens its doors onto Gear Bridge.
variants.ride_on: Riding past the station, you startle the drowsy driver at his desk. You transfer quickly onto a loud sidecar motorbike, racing to the warm lights of Midnight Radio Repair.
